vo.text: It was heard four thousand eight hundred kilometers away. People thought it was cannon fire.
vo.cap: Heard *4,800 km* away. People thought it was *cannon fire.*

vo.text: It was a volcano. Krakatoa, August 1883.
Its pressure wave circled the Earth more than three times.
vo.cap: The pressure wave circled Earth *3+ times.*

vo.text: Tsunamis up to forty-two meters. At least thirty-six thousand people died.
vo.cap: Tsunamis up to *42 m.* At least *36,000* dead.

vo.text: For months, sunsets around the world glowed red.
Would you live next to a volcano? Tell me in the comments. And subscribe for more.

cta.q: Would you live next to a volcano?
